name: Elad
title: Ephraim's Descendant Killed by the Men of Gath
summary: Elad was a descendant of Ephraim, Joseph's son. He was killed along with his brother Ezer by the men of Gath when they tried to steal their livestock. His father's grief over this loss is mentioned in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Elad's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Elad is mentioned as one of Ephraim's descendants in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Killed by the Men of Gath
keyEvents.description: Elad and his brother Ezer were killed by the men of Gath when they went down to take their livestock. This was a tragic event in the history of Ephraim's family.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Sorrow
keyEvents.description: Ephraim, Elad's father, mourned for a long time over the loss of his sons, and his brothers came to comfort him.

keyEvents.title: Beriah Born After the Tragedy
keyEvents.description: After Elad and Ezer died, Ephraim had another son whom he named Beriah, because disaster had come upon his household.
